The '''Malthee Crater''' was a large crater formed by the [[Massacre at Malthee|bombardment]] of [[Malthee]], which destroyed the [[City/Legends|city]]. The crater was surrounded by a rim of [[Granite/Legends|granite]] on which the names of the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] killed in the bombardment were written. Gran often traveled to the crater.<ref name="Strongholds" />
